# LOi

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Multi-brand online retailer based in Montevideo. Sells phones, notebooks, TVs, speakers, consoles, home appliances, furniture, beauty, toys, sports goods and grocery, including its own brands NAPPO and KOLKE. Ships within Uruguay; Chile is served by a separate site.

*ES:* Tienda online multimarca con sede en Montevideo. Vende celulares, notebooks, televisores, parlantes, consolas, electrodomésticos, muebles, belleza, juguetes, deportes y almacén, incluyendo sus marcas propias NAPPO y KOLKE. Envía dentro de Uruguay; Chile se atiende desde otro sitio.

## Shopping notes

Search results load with JavaScript, so the search page HTML shows few results; product pages are server-rendered and carry the model code in the title. Prices are in Uruguayan pesos. The store publishes llms.txt and faq-ai.txt with company, shipping and payment facts.
